description: This is a test source file for Orleans-based lease queue balancer functionality, focusing on Azure Storage integration, auto-scaling, and node failure scenarios. It contains test cases and configuration setup for Orleans test clusters, specifically testing lease-based queue balancing behavior in different cluster states.

classes.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancerTests
classes.description: Contains test methods for lease-based queue balancer functionality, cluster auto-scaling, and handling node failures within an Orleans test environment.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use Azure Blob Lease Provider, Azure Storage clustering, memory streams, and logging for test scenarios.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with initial silo count and custom configurator.

methods.name: LeaseBalancedQueueBalancer_SupportAutoScaleScenario
methods.description: Test case that verifies the auto-scaling behavior of the lease-based queue balancer during silo addition and removal.

methods.name: LeaseBalancedQueueBalancer_SupportUnexpectedNodeFailureScenerio
methods.description: Test case that verifies the resilience of the lease-based queue balancer during unexpected node failures.

methods.name: AgentManagerOwnCorrectAmountOfAgents
methods.description: Checks if the management grain reports the correct number of agent ownerships across silos.
